COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

2. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Security.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning Relational Database Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Relational Database Fundamentals.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Data Representation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Representation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Representation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data Representation.

9. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Web Development Fundamentals.

10. When learning Structured Query Language, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Structured Query Language.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Structured Query Language.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Structured Query Language.

11. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Logic Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Circuits.

12. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Data Representation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Binary Arithmetic Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Logic Gates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.

3. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.

5. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. D — Information and Communication Technology

7. B — CPU

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
